title: Barbell Bench Press
description: 1. Lie with the eyes under the racked bar, plant the feet, draw the shoulder blades back, and grip the bar evenly. 2. Unrack with control, lower the bar toward the mid-chest while keeping the wrists stacked over the forearms. 3. Press the bar back to straight arms without bouncing it, then re-rack with a spotter when appropriate.
